about.title: About Us
about.text: Located in El Hamiz, Midea Arcodym Elhamiz has been serving families for over 10 years. We specialize in home appliances from trusted brands like Midea, Arcodym, and S-Challenge. Our goal is simple: offer quality products at fair prices, with reliable support before and after your purchase. Customers usually contact us to check availability, then visit our store to see the products and choose with confidence.

reviews.title: What Our Customers Say
reviews.subtitle: Trusted by thousands of customers across Algeria
reviews.review1: Very good prices and helpful service. I found exactly what I needed.
reviews.review2: We contacted them before visiting, and everything was ready.
reviews.review3: Reliable store with good after-sales support.
reviews.review4: Bought an air conditioner for our living room. Installation was smooth and the team guided us through the settings.
reviews.review5: The prices are competitive and the products are genuine. Recommended for families looking for trusted appliances.
reviews.review6: Fast response when we called. They confirmed stock availability and we picked it up the same day.
